name: fantazia-app-shells
description: Source-only Android and Windows wrappers for the hosted Fantazia game

scripts.android:add: npm run configure && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run configure && cap sync android
scripts.windows:build: npm run configure && electron-builder --win nsis --config desktop/builder.json
scripts.check: node --check configure.cjs && node --check desktop/main.cjs && node config.test.cjs
